violations.description: Publication job does not run tests.
violations.evidence: The publish-pypi job in .github/workflows/publish.yaml does not run tests, nor does it strictly gate against a successful test run from a previous workflow. The build job (which the publish job depends on) does not include a test step.
violations.recommendation: Ensure tests are run as part of the build or release process, either by making publish jobs depend on a successful test job or by explicitly including a test step.
